description:
Durable record of owner decisions (question dialog, 2026-10-18) and guardrails for remediating the autogenerated issues in BenchBox-dev/benchbox (63 issues, 55 bot-created, 14 of 15 open). Source: adversarial review of the issue inventory with logs, source and artifacts.

DECISIONS
D1 Nightly lifecycle: reopen the most recently closed issue for the t3:<domain> label (closed within 14 days) instead of creating a new one; comment only when the failed-job signature changes; cancelled = no verdict (comment on an open issue; never create or close); skipped = no change; a passing domain still closes its issue; update docs/internal/nightly-t3.md; no new labels.
D2 Soundness gaps: the digest re-evaluates open gap issues each run and closes them when the entry no longer needs attention or an authorized attester posts 'External review: <reviewer>' on the gap issue; the issue body names the reason class. Which threads are flagged is NOT narrowed (verified: they are author overrides and deferrals of oracle High/Medium findings).
D3 Durations: decouple from correctness: t3:durations fails only on duration-tooling failure (missing verdict or junit, pytest exit >1); failing sampled tests warn. Precondition: prove the release canary selection covers the slow tier.
D4 Ownership: tracker items only; no GitHub assignees.
D5 Soundness gate: the agent never posts stand-in or external-review attestations and never re-runs the oracle; without an oracle verdict the item waits with an exact NEXT_ACTION.
D6 The site repo BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site is in scope: open and merge PRs there under that repo's gates.
D7 Hosted writes: workflow_dispatch of workflows the batch changed; evidence comments on alert issues; close an issue only when a green run proves its cause fixed. Never reopen #2662-#2667 or #2774. Never close gap issues that still need attention (#3125, #3126, #2806, #2807, #2808).
D8 Completion: merged code + unit tests + a green dispatch/CI run of the changed workflow. Scheduled-run confirmation is a follow-up check, not a blocker.
D9 Windows: fix all five failures; no quarantine.
D10 Privacy gate: the agent may fix producer/serializer code and tests; relaxing the public privacy contract, a validator rule or the 1.0 clean-rate floor blocks the item for the owner.
D11 Mirror PRs: apply owner decision D-A1 to new auto/results-mirror-* PRs: squash-merge only if base == live published-results tip, the full diff is inside the sync allowlist, and corpus-mirror/validate-bundles is green; close superseded mirror PRs with 'Superseded by #N'. Otherwise WAITING.

NON-ACTIONS AND RE-HOMED SCOPE
- Perf aggregate floor: existing t3-perf-aggregate-gate-tolerance-decision-20261009 (updated with the integer-millisecond baseline evidence).
- Comment-policy base-read conflict behind #3081/#3084: existing comment-policy-digest-and-base-exception-catch22-20261008 (partly delivered by #3019).
- Windows fast-test stall: existing windows-fast-test-stall-cause-20261017.
- Linkcheck 403 and quarantine exit 5: historical; D1 reopen semantics cover recurrence; no change.
- Retired bot families (develop-red, TODO export, fast-lane ceiling, auto-revert, drain queue): no action.
- Explorer read-model sequencing between core and site: autogen-site-contract-bump-sequencing-20261018 (follow-up outside this batch).

GUARDRAILS
G1 Mode: serial controller, one claim at a time; ledger .todo-batch/autogen-issues.txt (ignored via .git/info/exclude, never committed); tracker holds state; no handoff files.
G2 Writes: never edit the primary clone. Per item: make worktree-create BRANCH=<type>/<slug> WORKTREE_PATH=../BenchBox.wt-<slug>; make agent-write-preflight; stage explicit paths only (never git add -A); resolve git identity and its config origin before the first commit, reject agent identities, no agent co-author trailers; Python via uv run --; make pr-preflight once, then make pr-open and make pr-arm; squash to develop; terminal state is a merged PR. Site repo: read its AGENTS.md first and use its equivalents.
G3 Source and text: no explanatory comments or docstrings in maintained code (run make comment-policy-check); commit and PR text written for a reader who never saw this session (no item ids, wave or plan references).
G4 Soundness: never post 'Stand-in oracle review' or 'External review:' comments; never re-run the oracle; never remove a hold label or bypass a required check. Fix and push on Critical/High oracle findings; a refusal or missing verdict means release the claim, record WAITING and an exact NEXT_ACTION for the owner.
G5 Hosted writes are limited to D7, D11 and the PRs/branches of this batch. No settings, secrets, variables or rulesets. Labels only where an item names them.
G6 Never make a gate pass by weakening it: no looser thresholds, continue-on-error, skip/xfail/quarantine, narrowed marker expressions or deleted assertions. Fixes must be root-cause or evidence-backed. If the only path to green weakens a gate, block the item with the evidence.
G7 No new secrets, repositories, unpinned image references or dependencies.
G8 Public branch published-results changes only through D11 mirror PRs.
G9 Evidence: before finish, record in the item context the commands run, failing-before/passing-after result, PR URL and merge SHA, and run URLs. Never claim a check that was not run; unobserved facts are labelled INFERENCE.
G10 Waiting: never sleep or poll; take at most one gate snapshot per item per invocation; if a gate is pending, release the claim, record WAITING with NEXT_ACTION in the ledger, continue with other eligible items.
G11 Scope: out-of-scope findings become create_item follow-ups with needs on the current item; no silent widening; narrowed scope must be re-homed to a named item.
G12 Freshness: before editing, re-read each living file and line cited in the item (line numbers are leads, not evidence); if the description conflicts with current code, stop and record the conflict.
